summary: Short text written by agents now shows its formatting instead of raw symbols. Question prompts, titles, options and answers render `code`, bold, italic and links the same way the conversation does, so a prompt like `NOPASSWD: darwin-rebuild` shows as inline code without the backticks. The same applies to sidebar descriptions and current work, the agent hover card, work-log rows and their tooltips, the tool detail header, tool summaries, error details, task lists and inbox and mission titles. Screen readers and tooltips get the plain text, without formatting symbols. Commands and file paths next to them stay verbatim as code. Raw HTML is still shown as text and is never run.

replay.detail: Presentation only; existing conversation, question and roster observations are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The kit adds InlineMarkdown, InlineCode and toPlainText exports. Existing callers remain valid; sidebar row descriptions in accessible names now omit Markdown markers.
